code:
use IO.Std.write_line

use ROOT = (persistence: int, digital_root: long)

digit_sum(value: long) -> long =>
    if value < 10L then
        value
    else
        value % 10L + digit_sum(value / 10L)
    fi

root(value: long) -> ROOT =>
    if value < 10L then
        (persistence = 0, digital_root = value)
    else
        let inner = root(digit_sum(value))

        (persistence = inner.persistence + 1,
         digital_root = inner.digital_root)
    fi

for number in [627615L, 39390L, 588225L, 393900588225L] do
    let result = root(number)

    write_line("{number} has additive persistence {result.persistence}"
        " and digital root {result.digital_root}")

use IO.Std.write_line

use ROOT = (persistence: int, digital_root: long)

digit_sum(value: long) -> long =>
    if value < 10L then
        value
    else
        value % 10L + digit_sum(value / 10L)
    fi

root(value: long) -> ROOT =>
    if value < 10L then
        (persistence = 0, digital_root = value)
    else
        let inner = root(digit_sum(value))

        (persistence = inner.persistence + 1,
         digital_root = inner.digital_root)
    fi

for number in [627615L, 39390L, 588225L, 393900588225L] do
    let result = root(number)

    write_line("{number} has additive persistence {result.persistence}"
        " and digital root {result.digital_root}")
